notes.title: Krieg is now free... Refunds for those who have purchased!
notes.notes:
In an attempt to be as transparent as possible, this decision wasn't an easy one. After only a few days we've decided to make Krieg free to play. Everyone who has purchased the game, we cannot thank you enough. Your belief in our game means the world to us, and I'm not sure if it's an automatic process or you have to physically hit the refund button, but EVERYONE can get a refund and enjoy the game for free. Let me explain our reasoning behind this decision.

Our plans for this game are huge, and our team is unfortunately still very small. This means our time is stretched incredibly thin no matter how we end up spending it. Our hope was that we could raise enough money with Krieg that we could pour every penny back into developing a more solid back-end, more robust matchmaking, singleplayer/co-op missions, new characters, new maps... and while we still fully intend to add all these things, we've realized that VR is still in its infancy, and we can't depend on the market supporting our game no matter how good it is. The barrier to entry is just too high, and the market is just too small to support all the good games that are coming out almost daily... just check http://vrlfg.net/ to better grasp the point I'm trying to make. Even the BEST multiplayer VR games have at MOST 100 players online at a time, sometimes pushing past 150. When you compare that to PUBG 500,000 players online in the middle of the day, with a 1.5 million peak in the last 24 hours... it's easy to see the difference. Our goal with making the game free is to get it into as many hands as possible. It's a potentially large loss of revenue, but in the end if more people are able to play, that's a win in our book. Perhaps things will change down the line, but at least for now (and the foreseeable future), please enjoy Krieg for free :-) 

Much Love,
Castle Steps Team

notes.title: Game being delayed :(
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! As much as it pains me to say it, we're going to have to delay the game most likely by about a week. We made some small mistakes that have turned into larger ones, and long story short we don't feel comfortable releasing the full game without the demo. The demo hasn't been approved yet by the awesome people at Steam due to our screw ups. If the demo can be approved today, we'll be releasing later today, but more than likely the game won't be approved until next week... The reasoning behind this is that our demo will essentially be the full game minus two characters, as we want everyone to be able to try the game without any risk. We recognize that it's an early access title, there are bugs, and we know not everyone is comfortable spending money on a product (that we think is awesome!) but definitely has a couple issues. The plan is to reinvest everything we make into more characters, single player / co-op missions, training modes similar to Super Smash Bros... tons of large plans.The demo will also help keep the servers full, which is never a bad thing :-)

We're also seeing if Steam will let us do a free weekend on our opening weekend in an attempt to stay on schedule, but the chances of that happening are pretty slim as well. Will try and keep everyone posted! Much love to everyone who has been helping us beta test, balance, bug fix, and overall help us build the best class based VR game possible! Thank you!!

Love,
Castle Steps Team
Gehrig
Bryce
Evan
Kevin
